data.description:
Audit all new scripts and hooks added by this epic for config keys consumed via read-config.sh, document them in CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md; also document behavioral constraints in KNOWN-ISSUES.md.

## Testing Mode: UPDATE

No executable behavior — python3 positional assertions for doc presence.

## Files to Modify

- MODIFY `plugins/dso/docs/CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md`
- MODIFY `.claude/docs/KNOWN-ISSUES.md` (or project-level KNOWN-ISSUES.md — check which exists)

## Part 1: CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md

Audit each new or modified script from this epic for read-config.sh calls:
- `plugins/dso/scripts/check-unacked-degradations.sh` (new)
- `plugins/dso/scripts/validate-ack-rationale.sh` (new)
- `plugins/dso/scripts/preconditions-ack.sh` (new)
- `plugins/dso/hooks/check-precondition-emit.sh` (new)

For each config key found, add a documentation entry following the existing format in CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md.

If NO new config keys are found (scripts use only env vars, not read-config.sh), document that explicitly with a one-line note: "The PRECONDITIONS degradation channel and ack mechanism introduce no new configuration keys; behavior is configured via TICKETS_TRACKER_DIR env var (existing) and DSO_TICKETS_TRACKER_DIR env var (existing override pattern)."

## Part 2: KNOWN-ISSUES.md

Add entries for these known behavioral constraints:

1. **Non-Latin precondition text requires human ack review**
   - Symptom: `dso preconditions-ack` exits 2 with MANUAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED message
   - Root cause: automated 3-word-window validation cannot reliably match non-Latin text
   - Workaround: a human reviewer must manually verify the rationale and perform the ack with their own --if-skipped text that references an English translation of the precondition

2. **Cross-worktree ack race window**
   - Symptom: check-unacked-degradations.sh may not see ACKs written by another worktree session in the same atomic window
   - Root cause: ACK files are written to the tickets branch; if the tickets branch has not been synced between worktrees, the check may miss ACKs
   - Workaround: run `.claude/scripts/dso ticket sync` (or equivalent) between worktrees before running check-unacked-degradations.sh

Check .claude/docs/DOCUMENTATION-GUIDE.md for KNOWN-ISSUES entry format.

## Acceptance Criteria

### Universal
- Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh (exits 0)
- Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- Verify: ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py

### Task-Specific
- Verify: python3 -c "c=open('plugins/dso/docs/CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md').read(); exit(0 if 'PRECONDITIONS' in c or 'preconditions-ack' in c or 'degradation' in c else 1)"
- Verify: test -f .claude/docs/KNOWN-ISSUES.md && python3 -c "c=open('.claude/docs/KNOWN-ISSUES.md').read(); exit(0 if 'non-Latin' in c.lower() or 'Non-Latin' in c else 1)" || python3 -c "c=open('KNOWN-ISSUES.md').read(); exit(0 if 'non-Latin' in c.lower() or 'Non-Latin' in c else 1)"
data.title: UPDATE: Document new config keys and behavioral constraints in CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md and KNOWN-ISSUES.md
